title: Over-the-rib insertion
view: Coronal section through one intercostal space at the mid-axillary line, head at the top: skin on the image left, pleural cavity and lung on the right; the same way round as the needle decompression inset.
teachingPoint: The vein, artery and nerve run in the groove under each rib; the tube goes over the top of the lower rib, well clear of them.
claims: Neurovascular bundle (vein, artery, nerve) along the inferior margin of each rib (record).
Tube passes over the superior border of the lower rib into the pleural space (record).
Bundle in the costal groove between the internal and innermost intercostal muscles, vein highest and nerve lowest (standard anatomy).
Skin, subcutaneous fat and serratus anterior over the ribs at the mid-axillary line (standard anatomy).
Pleural space drawn opened, lung behind it; a 24 Fr tube (about 8 mm) to scale (schematic).
Labels: Rib, Vein, artery, nerve, Lower rib, Chest tube, Parietal pleura, Lung.
